messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Weight loss starts slowly in the first 4 weeks of treatment.
Changes in appetite and a feeling of fullness with fewer cravings occur during this time.
Then, more measurable weight loss occurs in the first 2 to 3 months.
Weight loss increases over 6 to 12 months (SURMOUNT-1).
To learn more, see ” How long does it take for Zepbound to work?"
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has effect on appetite", "changes in appetite and a feeling of fullness with fewer cravings"]

The relation 'has effect on appetite' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug influences the appetite-related effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'may affect': The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
D. 'acts in': The subject drug exerts its effects within the anatomical or physiological system specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
